verdict.rationale: Docs describe an official MCP server enabling Claude, Cursor, Windsurf or any MCP client to run Browser Use tasks (browser-use-docs-12, browser-use-probe-3), but a hands-on community report says the author had to switch tools because Browser Use 'doesn't support MCP integration' in Cursor (browser-use-comm-4), directly contradicting the documented claim. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that MCP connection actually works end-to-end, and resolution of the conflicting user report.
